Columns: Field # / Crop, Moisture (how wet the soil is), Stress (how hard the crop is fighting dry spells), Irrigation (water help covering this field), Status (Healthy / Warning / Critical).

The strip below names the field, then Next says what to do first: - Critical or Warning Moisture → water that field (turn on irrigation if covered, or spray WATER / place coverage) - High Stress or a sensitive growth window → protect now; stress today cuts harvest later - Looking fine → recheck later; worse fields first
